name: Widow Re-marriage Scheme
benefit: If any widow re-marries, a cheque of ₹ 20,000/- is given to the women and a Fix Deposit worth ₹ 30,000/- for the 5 years term is given to the couple.
_eligibility_text:
1. The widow should have remarried.
1. The applicant should be a resident of Himachal Pradesh.
1. Groom should not be less than 21 years of age
1. Women should not be less than 18 years of age.
